modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Your hand-luggage allowance depends on the fare your ticket was issued at.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 piece of hand luggage, no larger than 55×40×23 cm. Hand luggage over this size must go in the hold as a paid oversize service (up to 10 kg and 138 cm in total dimensions).

carryon_weight.value: Up to 10 kg or up to 15 kg, depending on the fare.
carryon_weight.notes: Translated from NordStar's Russian page. The page lists the allowances without naming the fares they belong to.

personal_item.value: In addition to the allowance: a handbag, briefcase or backpack of no more than 5 kg, plus a cane, crutches or wheelchair.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Some fares include checked baggage; others include hand luggage only.

allowance_by_fare.value: Depending on the fare, the free allowance is one of: 1 piece of hand luggage up to 10 kg (no checked bag); 1 piece of hand luggage up to 10 kg + 1 bag up to 23 kg; 1 piece of hand luggage up to 15 kg + 1 bag up to 30 kg; or 1 piece of hand luggage up to 15 kg + 2 bags of up to 30 kg each. The allowance may be reduced or increased on some routes and periods; on charter flights it is shown on the itinerary receipt.
allowance_by_fare.notes: Translated from NordStar's Russian page. The page does not label which fare carries which allowance.

size.value: One checked bag must not exceed 203 cm in total of its three dimensions.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 24 hours and closes 1 hour before departure.

airport_cutoff.value: Airport check-in opens no less than 2 hours before the departure time on your ticket (it can differ by airport) and closes 40 minutes before departure; closing times at airports abroad may differ.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
